caption: We cut our Monday huddle to one question.
transcript: Our team huddle used to be a scoreboard. Everyone read their numbers and nobody learned anything. So we cut it to one question: which conversation from last week do you wish you could redo? Then we role-play that one call for ten minutes. Follow-up got better within a month, because people stopped hiding the calls that went sideways. If you lead a team, take the question, not the meeting.
